axes: Initial LiDAR x forward, y left, z up
z_definition: LiDAR points use z=0 for the scan plane; visual points have triangulated height in that same local frame. This is sparse visual structure, not a dense 3D reconstruction.
point_order: LiDAR scan points first, followed by triangulated camera landmarks
localization_note: Use only the LiDAR scan plane for 2D scan localization; do not project visual XYZ into this plane.
temporal_filter: Conservative temporal filter: removes strong visible-free conflicts; retains insufficient evidence

grid_derivation.method: Original occupied cell centers without retained LiDAR point support are masked to unknown
grid_derivation.interpretation: Conservative raster companion; no free-space inference from removed point endpoints
